description_en: Unlocks one or more users of a bastion host
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost unlock-users --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-ids 1_,_2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnlockUsers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host to which the users to be unlocked belong.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
要解锁的用户所在堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the users to be unlocked belong.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要解锁的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user that you want to unlock. The value is a JSON string. You can add up to 100 user IDs. If you specify multiple IDs, separate the IDs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the ID of the user
parameters.help_zh:
要解锁的用户ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多支持设置100个用户ID，多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取用户ID
parameters.name: user_ids

OK: The call was successful.

  \

  NoteMake sure that the request parameters are valid and call the operation again.

  \

  NoteCheck whether the specified ID of the bastion host exists, whether the specified hosts exist, and whether the specified host IDs are valid. Then, call the operation again.

OK：操作成功。

INVALID_ARGUMENT：请求参数设置错误。
